text: Long catch up with Chioma over lunch. Her driving test is 14 November, third attempt, and she's properly nervous about the roundabouts. Her brother Tunde passed first time which isn't helping. Remind me to text her good luck the night before.

Coffee with Duc and Ioana. Duc's moving to Leeds sometime in the spring, no firm date yet. Ioana has her citizenship test on 3rd of March 2027 and says she's revising every evening. She's vegetarian now too, apparently since the summer. Duc's partner hasn't found a job up there yet, so it might slip to the autumn. We said we'd do a leaving meal before he goes, probably early March.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax before 30/11, book boiler service for after Christmas.
Rang Mum's friend Suzanne back. Her grandson's results day is 13 August so she'll know about uni then. She's still doing the allotment, mostly beans and courgettes this year.

Saw Gareth at the station. He's finally sitting the CFA exams in March 2027, the firm's paying. Seemed relaxed about it, says he's done the first two levels already and this is the last one. They've got a study room set up in the loft now. His wife Bridget is expecting in the new year, due around late January.
Dentist moved to 9 Dec. I'm taking the train down to Bristol on the 12th and back on the 15th.
Henrik's audition for the conservatoire was yesterday. He thinks it went badly but they said results soonish, maybe end of the month. Need to ask him how the second round went if he gets one.
Quick call with Zainab. The barbecue on Saturday is off because her dad's not well. She's going over to his on Sunday instead. I should check in with her on Monday.
Mariam Kowalski from work, goes by Mari. Starts her MSc part time in January 2027. Loves bouldering, does it three nights a week. Allergic to nuts, worth remembering for the Christmas do.
Wiremu and his partner Phoebe are doing their dive certification together on 6 June 2027 in Dahab. They've been saving since last year. Phoebe's a bit scared of the deep water part though.
Note to self: book my own theory test before the end of the month. Slots are filling up into spring.

Dinner at Ali and Shanice's. Their daughter has her grade 5 piano exam on 21st of November and has been practising nonstop. Shanice says she cries every time she gets the scales wrong. Ali has a new job at the council starting 4 January. Their dog Biscuit is still eating socks. Don't forget to send Ali congrats properly, I only said it in passing.

Dev passed his driving test!! Second go. Wants to buy a little Fiesta sometime next month. His sister Emily is still on lessons and says she'll book hers for the spring. Their dad's offered to insure them both, which is generous. Remind me to send Dev a proper congrats message tonight.

Yuki's mum is having her knee done on 2 December 2026. Yuki is flying back to Osaka for a few weeks around then, possibly staying till New Year. She's anxious about the surgery. Remind me to message Yuki the week after to see how her mum is.

Caught up with Arturo and Ignacio after five a side. Ignacio's coaching badge assessment is in the spring, he doesn't know the date yet. Arturo has his citizenship interview 17/02. Both want to do a Spain trip together after.
Matteo said his sister Lindiwe, no wait, his sister-in-law Lindiwe, got into the nursing course starting September 2027. He's dead proud. She's been working at the care home for six years.
Got to sort the passport renewal soon. Photos first, then post office. Ideally before February.
Andile messaged. His bar exam results come out 28 October and he can't sleep. His girlfriend has been keeping him busy with films. Must ring him on the 28th, whatever happens.
Emily's hen do was meant to be in Lisbon in May but it's been called off, the wedding's postponed to 2028. She seemed fine about it honestly. Her fiancé Dong lost his job last month which is why.
Anil's son did his eleven plus last week. Results not till 1 March 2027. Anil seemed more nervous than the kid. Ask him about it then.

Long chat with Tobi. He's leaving the bank at the end of the year to retrain as an electrician. Course starts sometime in January, assessments every few months. He's got a cat now, Pepper, rescue. Said the flat is too small for the two of them. Lives in Walthamstow still. His brother Dawit is getting married 8th of August 2027, Tobi's best man and terrified of the speech.
Shopping: printer ink, birthday card for nobody yet, bin bags. Return the jacket by 14/11.
Phoebe mentioned her mum's 70th is 19 March. They're doing a meal somewhere in Cardiff. She'd love a cashmere scarf apparently, Phoebe said grey not navy.
Ivan rang. Medical school interview at Edinburgh on 9 December, and another at King's in the new year. Really wants Edinburgh. I said I'd do a mock with him next weekend.
Henrik got through! Second round audition is 4th of February. Remind me to send him a good luck message that morning.

Bumped into Caitlin Brennan and her husband in Sainsbury's. They're taking the kids to Disneyland Paris at Easter. Caitlin's back at uni finishing her teaching qualification, placement till June. She looked shattered.
Driving lesson Thursday 5pm. Mock test with the instructor on 22 Nov, real one hopefully early January.
Chioma failed again, the roundabout thing. Gutted. She says she's not booking another until spring. I need to take her out for a drink soon and not mention cars.
Suzanne and Gareth's ruby anniversary is 2nd of October next year. Their kids are planning a surprise party, keeping it quiet. Should chip in for the gift when they ask.
Dawit says the wedding venue is booked, 8 August 2027 in Addis. He and his fiancée want everyone there a week early. Need to look at flights after Christmas when prices drop.
Spoke to Zainab again. Her dad's out of hospital as of Friday. She's going part time for a bit to look after him. Was quieter than usual.
Lindiwe has her NMC test in October 2027, her first proper exam in years. Matteo says she's already making flashcards.
Clear out the garage this weekend. Tip run Sunday morning. Sell the old bike sometime before the spring.
Saw Alejandro at Dev's housewarming. He's a sound engineer now, mostly theatre work. Supports Atletico, will not shut up about it. Doesn't drink. Lives in Peckham with two cats.
Ioana's citizenship test went well, she got 22 out of 24! Ceremony is sometime in May. Remind me to get her a card.
Mariam (Mari) failed her first stats module exam and has a resit 10 April. She's okay but stressed. I should offer to go through some past papers with her.

Anan's daughter is doing her black belt grading on 30 November. Anan's taking the day off for it. He also mentioned his wife's promotion, head of pharmacy from 1 January. They're celebrating with a weekend in York sometime in February. Their son is struggling a bit with the new school and keeps asking to move back to his old one. Anan reckons it'll settle down after Christmas.
Need to get the car MOT done by 18/12. Also new wipers.

Ali's daughter got a distinction in her piano exam! Shanice sent a video. Grade 6 next, maybe in the summer. Would be nice to send something small, she mentioned she wants a metronome that clicks loudly.
Gareth and Bridget had the baby early, 3 January, little girl called Nia. Both doing well. Must sort a present and a card this week.

Long walk with Dong. He's got two interviews lined up, one 5 November and one possibly in a fortnight, both in logistics. Emily is still at the library. They've stopped looking at wedding venues for now. He's quite low but says the interviews help.
Andile passed the bar!! Call him tonight.
Tunde's starting a plumbing apprenticeship in February 2027. Chioma says he's buzzing. He's 19.
My own plan for the new year: sign up for the Spanish B1 exam in June, maybe the 7th. Start classes after Christmas.
Arturo's citizenship interview got moved to 3rd of March. He's annoyed, had already taken 17 Feb off. Remind me to ask Arturo how it went that week.
Emily's brother Dev is doing a half marathon on 26 April. First one. Training plan starts next month. He wants proper running headphones, could be a birthday idea.
Dinner with Wiremu. He's switched teams at work, now on the data side. Phoebe's mum loved the scarf. They're thinking about moving to Wellington sometime in 2028, nothing decided.

Chat with Yuki after she got back. Her mum's recovering well, walking with a stick. Yuki's got her JLPT N1 exam on 6 July and is terrified. Her flatmate Bridget is helping her revise. Don't forget to wish Yuki luck.
Ignacio passed the coaching assessment, now UEFA C licensed. Starting with the under 12s in September.
Book flights for Dawit's wedding: arrive by 1 August 2027, back around the 12th. Check visa rules first.
Andile's girlfriend Ama is sitting her driving test on 12 December. He says she's calm about it. They're also looking at flats in Brixton in the spring.

Tobi's course started. He said the first practical assessment is 20/03 and he's nervous because he's the oldest there. Pepper is fine, knocked a plant over. I should send him a message the day before.
Library books due Friday. Haircut sometime next week.

Lunch with Suzanne, Gareth and the baby. Nia's christening is 14 May at St Mary's. Bridget is back at work in September. Suzanne kept saying she wants to go to Iceland, maybe next autumn, for her 65th.
Mari passed her resit!! She's moving onto the dissertation over the summer. Need to take her out for dinner to celebrate.

Matteo's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral probably the week after next, in Turin. Matteo's flying out Wednesday with his sister-in-law Lindiwe and the kids. He was very matter of fact on the phone but I could tell he was struggling. His mum is staying in Turin for a while after. Remind me to call him when he's back.
Anil's son got into the grammar school. Anil was emotional on the phone. They're doing a little family dinner on Saturday.
Caitlin finished her placement, qualified teacher from 1 September. She's applying for jobs in Kent. Her husband's not keen on moving though.
Pay council tax, cancel the gym, sort out the window cleaner. All before the end of the month.

Ivan heard nothing from Edinburgh yet, should be sometime in February or March. King's interview was 15/01 and he thinks it went okay. His mum keeps asking him every day which isn't helping. I need to check in with Ivan next week.
